prompt: The notation ⊨ φ (with no premises on the left) means:
options: φ can be derived using the proof rules
φ is true in every model (it is valid)
hint: ⊨ is about truth in models. ⊢ is about proofs.
explanation: ⊨ φ says φ is true in every interpretation, so φ is valid. ⊢ φ says φ is provable. Soundness and completeness say the two agree.
